title: 第19章 突破紫府第20章 天阴老人到来
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
离开了落阴山后，周家老祖并没有立刻离去，而是站在原地，若有所思地回头凝视着天阴宗的方向。
他的眉头微皱，似乎有什么事情让他感到担忧和不安。
那种不好的预感就像一片阴影，一直笼罩在他的心头，挥之不去。
“天阴老人恐怕没那么好心，他的目的应该不只是斩杀李家老祖这么简单！”周家老祖暗自思忖道。
“那会是什么呢？”周家老祖苦思冥想，但一时之间却无法想明白天阴老人的真正目的。
然而，现在并不是思考这个问题的时候。
周家老祖很快便将心中的疑虑压下，然后收回目光，没再去看天阴宗的方向。
接着转身，头也不回地朝着北源河畔的方向疾驰而去。
……
时间一晃，转眼又是半月过去。
落凤岭李家所在，家族修行之地。
突然一股强大的气势从李天行身上爆发出来。
然而，这还没完，他的气息还在稳步提升着！
后山，湖心小筑。
李北玄身着一袭青衫，悠然自得地盘坐在小筑之中，手持钓竿，垂钓于那波光粼粼的湖面之上。
就在李天行突破境界的一刹那，这那股气势就已经被李北玄感知到了。
只见他嘴角微微上扬，脸上露出一抹满意的笑容。
接着他缓缓抬起头，目光投向家族所在的方向。
“终于突破了啊！”李北玄轻声笑道，“一阶灵药的效果果然不错！”
“看来这些有了品阶的灵药真是好东西啊！自己以后可要多多搜罗一些灵药回来，好反哺给族人。”

突然间，一个念头闪过他的脑海。
“嗯，要是利用这些有品阶的灵药，让族人们相互竞争，彼此激励，是否能够形成一种良性的内卷氛围？”
李北玄越想越觉得这个主意可行。
毕竟，这些有品阶的灵药，它们的数量总是有限的。
若是定下规矩，在规定的时间内，谁能够最大程度地提升自己的实力，谁就能获得灵药奖励。
“这个方法似乎真的可行。”李北玄自言自语道，“不过，具体的细节还需要再斟酌一下。
等过后让天行去把我的想法补充完整吧！”
想到这里，李北玄的心情愈发愉悦起来。
他放下手中的钓竿，站起身来，活动了一下筋骨。
“现在，便让我来看看，从先天初期突破到先天中期，究竟能给我带来多少修为点！”
说着，李北玄将他的数据面板调了出来。
家族：北源李氏
境界：先天圆满（0800）+
寿元：456天
李氏族人：120人，其中锻体期73人，后天境初期18人，后天中期13人，后天后期10人，后天圆满4人，先天境初期1人，先天中期1人。
修为点：839
当看到最后那个修为点数时，李北玄心中不由得激动起来。
这半个多月时间，除了有一位族人突破到了后天境界之外，便是现在突破的李天行了。
“哈哈哈，修为点终于是够突破紫府境界了！”
他穿越过来，将近一年的时间，今天之后，他终于不用担心寿元问题了！
content_en:
After leaving Luoyin Mountain, the ancestor of the Zhou family did not leave immediately, but stood there, looking back thoughtfully in the direction of Tianyin Sect.
His brows furrowed slightly, as if something made him worried and uneasy.
That bad premonition was like a shadow that lingered in his mind.
"I'm afraid Old Man Tianyin doesn't have such good intentions. His purpose should be more than just killing the ancestor of the Li family!" The ancestor of the Zhou family thought to himself.
"What could that be?" The ancestor of the Zhou family thought hard, but for a while he couldn't figure out the true purpose of Old Man Tianyin.
However, now is not the time to ponder this question.
The ancestor of the Zhou family quickly suppressed the doubts in his heart, then looked away, not looking in the direction of Tianyin Sect.
Then he turned around and galloped towards the Beiyuan River without looking back.
…
Time flies, and half a month passes in the blink of an eye.
Luo Fengling is where the Li family is located, the place where the family practices.
Suddenly a powerful momentum burst out from Li Tianxing.
However, this is not over yet, his aura is still improving steadily!
Behind the mountain, there is a small building in the middle of the lake.
Li Beixuan was wearing a green shirt, sitting leisurely in the small building, holding a fishing rod, fishing on the sparkling lake.
The moment Li Tianxing broke through the realm, Li Beixuan had already sensed this momentum.
The corners of his mouth were raised slightly, and a satisfied smile appeared on his face.
Then he slowly raised his head and looked in the direction of his family.
"Finally a breakthrough!" Li Beixuan chuckled softly, "The effect of the first-order elixir is really good!"
"It seems that these high-grade elixirs are really good things! I will collect more elixirs in the future so that I can feed them back to my tribe."
Suddenly, an idea flashed through his mind.
"Well, if we use these high-grade elixirs to let the tribesmen compete with each other and encourage each other, can we create a benign involution atmosphere?"
The more Li Beixuan thought about it, the more he felt that this idea was feasible.
After all, the quantity of these high-grade elixirs is always limited.
If rules are set, whoever can improve his strength to the greatest extent within the specified time will be rewarded with the elixir.
"This method seems to be really feasible." Li Beixuan said to himself, "However, the specific details still need to be considered.
Let Tianxing complete my thoughts later! "
Thinking of this, Li Beixuan felt more and more happy.
He put down the fishing rod in his hand, stood up, and stretched his muscles.
"Now, let me see how many cultivation points a breakthrough from the early stage of Xiantian stage to the middle stage of Xiantian stage can bring to me!"
With that said, Li Beixuan brought up his data panel.
Family: Beiyuan Li family
Realm: Innate perfection (0800) +
Longevity: 456 days
There are 120 members of the Li clan, including 73 in the physical training stage, 18 in the early stage of the acquired state, 13 in the middle stage of the acquired state, 10 in the late stage of the acquired state, 4 in the consummation stage of the acquired state, 1 in the early stage of the innate state, and 1 in the middle stage of the innate state.
Cultivation points: 839
When he saw the last cultivation point, Li Beixuan couldn't help but get excited.
In the past half a month, except for one clan member who has broken through to the acquired realm, it is Li Tianxing who has made the breakthrough now.
"Hahaha, the cultivation points are finally enough to break through the Zifu realm!"
It's been nearly a year since he traveled back in time, and after today, he finally doesn't have to worry about his longevity!
